guidelinesCompliance.guideline: New public APIs must be documented.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: All new public SystemHealth value types, enums, accessors, constructors, and WeeklyRadarPublication health methods have rustdoc in src/features/weekly_radar/domain/system_health.rs and src/features/weekly_radar/domain/mod.rs.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep Weekly Radar Domain independent of Telegram, HTTP, Secret, network, database, Scheduler, persistence, rendering, and external providers.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The changed Domain files use only standard-library types and local Domain types; the provider-boundary source scan found no Telegram, HTTP, Secret, network, database, Scheduler, persistence, rendering, or external-provider dependency, and make check passed.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Consume only explicitly supplied facts; never derive HealthStatus, Stage, Ranking, Top5, or a trading/capital action.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: SystemHealth stores the caller-supplied HealthStatus, EvidenceCoverage, SourceCoverage, ExtractionFailure, DegradedCompany, and Freshness values without deriving them or touching Stage, Ranking, Top5, or trading/capital actions; system_health module tests cover explicit non-inference.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve supplied collection order and reject duplicate identities without replacing earlier facts.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: SystemHealth collection methods append in supplied order and return DuplicateIdentity before mutation; cargo test --lib system_health and the focused integration tests verify order, rejection, and retention of the first fact.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not add dependencies or modify shared architecture tests, global coverage policy, or unrelated Work Items.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The implementation adds no Cargo dependency and git diff shows no changes to shared architecture tests, global coverage policy, or unrelated Work Items; tests/mod_test.rs is a same-stem companion added only for this Domain registration path after the coverage guard identified it.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Resolve issues within this Work Item when they remain inside its Contract scope; do not broaden the boundary silently.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The only discovered coverage association issue was resolved within this WI by adding the scoped tests/mod_test.rs companion and amending the Contract with revalidation evidence; no shared policy or out-of-scope architecture file was changed.

risk.detail: The typed boundary is local and fully tested. Future renderers and provider adapters remain intentionally outside this WI and must consume the supplied SystemHealth without recomputation.

observedIssues: Initial coverage guard did not associate the changed weekly_radar/domain/mod.rs with the focused integration test; resolved within this WI by adding tests/mod_test.rs without changing shared coverage policy.
Reference-impact validation initially observed a stale generated target diagnostic; resolved by removing only the explicitly generated diagnostic and rerunning the canonical validator.
followUps: Later renderer and Telegram adapter WIs may consume WeeklyRadarPublication.system_health; they remain out of scope here.
Future ingestion/extraction WIs must supply health facts and freshness labels; this Domain does not calculate them.

residualRisks.detail: Markdown/Telegram renderers and provider delivery are not implemented by this WI and must preserve the typed facts without re-derivation.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.
